contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Add items and reserve, divide by batchSize, and round upward to an integer. Reserve is an extra quantity, not a percentage.
contract.domain: Items and reserve are integers from 0 through 1000; batchSize is an integer from 1 through 1000. Inputs are unchanged.

inputRoles.reserve: extra items to include before batching

contract.outputRole: number of batches for items plus reserve
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
